hooks.text: 父母身份、外观与五种职业树共同塑造角色
hooks.excerpt: Choose who your parents are, define your class and appearance, and begin your new life! Create your avatar starting from your parents' identities, and shape it with skills and traits acquired during your adventure. 5 Class Trees to choose from.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从学院宿舍起步，经工作、置业、交友与恋爱发展生活
hooks.excerpt: Start in a room at the dormitory with your childhood friend, but gradually grow wealthy and get your own place choosing from multiple options (you can also buy furniture) Get jobs (minigames) and befriend the townsfolk for quests, bonding or romance
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 33名同伴、14只宠物、21名可婚对象与至少190个任务
hooks.excerpt: More numbers to get to know Dungeon Dreams 2 - Total recruitable companions: 33 + 14 summons/pets - Total marriageable romances: 14 females, 7 males - Total temporary romantic flings: 5 female flings, 3 male flings - Total quests: at least 190 (based on unique journal entries). - Total buildigs (town improvements): 18 + 2 (DLC)
